rich_narrative.summary: The Abdul Sattar Edhi International Foundation operates as the U.S. fundraising arm for broad humanitarian initiatives in Pakistan, focusing on shelter, clothing, food delivery, healthcare, and emergency relief [2][3]. In FY2024, the organization recorded <cite id="2">$5,242,874 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting a 9% decline from the previous year's total of $5,752,945 [2]. The foundation allocated <cite id="3">95.4% of its expenses directly to program services</cite>, operating with exceptional fundraising efficiency [3]. Despite its operational legacy trace back to its founding in 1949, the organization presents balanced operational strengths and governance gaps [3]. While it directs substantial funds overseas—including <cite id="2">$2,612,196 in grants to its partner organization in Pakistan in FY2023</cite>—it holds significant reserves equal to 120.5 months of working capital, which creates a tradeoff regarding the immediate deployment of charitable resources [2][3].
